card.name: Kopanitsa
card.tagline: Lightning 11/16 line dance of western Bulgaria.
card.profile: A family of lively line dances from western Bulgaria (the Shop-Graovo region, also Thrace/Sredna Gora) in 11/16 meter, rhythm 2+2+3+2+2. Dancers form a curved line facing in, holding hands down or belts; many are 'called' dances where the leader on the right end signals pattern changes. Often very fast, with musicians speeding up to challenge the dancers. The name derives from kopam ('to dig/hoe') (English Wikipedia; Folkdance Footnotes).
card.insight: In northern Bulgaria the same 11/16 family is called gankino (after the girl's name Ganka); in western Thrace it is often krivo ('crooked'); related forms exist in Macedonia and Serbia (Kopacka) (English Wikipedia).
card.image_significance: Lively 11/16 Shop line dance. A representative image shows folk dress and patterned partner or group figures — Shop/Graovo, Bulgaria.
